patterns.note: Asymmetrical vertical text labels are fixed to the left and right edges of the viewport, providing persistent branding and a call to action.
Full-bleed hero sections dominate the initial viewport, using high-quality photography or video as a primary visual element.
High contrast between a muted, earthy palette used for content sections and a vibrant, unexpected accent color (bright yellow) for the footer.
The full-screen hero content dynamically changes its visual (e.g., from one video scene to another) on initial scroll before the entire hero section scrolls out of view.
The footer features a bold, solid background color that sharply contrasts with the main content area, making it a distinct visual block.

technique_notes: The initial hero uses a full-bleed video background that can transition its content (e.g., different video clips or still images) based on scroll depth or other triggers, before the entire hero section scrolls off-screen.
Key navigation elements and branding labels are implemented as sticky elements, fixed to the top and vertical edges of the viewport, maintaining presence throughout scrolling.
Sections are revealed by standard scrolling, with no complex fade-ins or slide-ups observed beyond the hero's content change.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, large serif for the primary brand mark, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for navigation and body text, with a clear hierarchy but not extreme size variations.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but a more compact layout in the footer.

standout: The most distinctive elements are the persistent vertical edge labels ('SIMON ROGAN', 'RESERVATION') that add a unique navigational and branding touch, and the bold, high-contrast yellow footer that abruptly shifts the site's color palette, creating a memorable visual break.
